evidence.text:
友好热情的氛氛围、员工和老板，加上非常合理的价格，使这里成为我最喜欢的社区咖啡馆。唯一能让它更好的是有本地面包师提供无麸质烘焙食品出售。

咖啡很好。非常好。他们卖La Colombe咖啡，而且知道怎么制作。他们还有十多种不错的茶选择，少量但精心挑选的烘焙食品、带奶油芝士和熏鲑鱼或其他配料的百吉饼，偶尔还有新鲜水果如香蕉出售，虽然绝对不是一顿完整的午餐。我听说百吉饼很棒。他们已经解决了饮品菜单的问题（另一条评论中提到散乱不清），墙上有一个清晰的横幅，我发现如果你问，他们总能想办法做出来。

有一个小的户外座位区，配有金属框架沙发和柔软干净的靠垫。非常适合春天和夏天，也是在这里社区结交新朋友的好地方。

前厅是一个放松的区域，可以工作、见人、和老板聊天（她在的时候），听她讲述她旅行丰富的生活故事。虽然她有时在工作时安静而不张扬，所以你可能需要主动提问才能让她开口。

员工也类似：安静、礼貌、高效、友好。问个问题，开始对话，他们就有丰富的生活经历可以分享。事实上，我在这里搭过话的大多数人都很有趣、有创意、鼓舞人心。也许是社区的原因，也许是咖啡因的作用，这里有些特别的东西。不装腔作势，从没见过男士发髻，人们真的会微笑。这很好。

后面有一个房间，有棋盘游戏、一张柔软干净的沙发和两把舒适的椅子，布置得像客厅/会客室，还有一张餐桌和椅子，非常适合学习小组和商务会议。

再加点俗气的话……作为摩羯座，我是发现这颗宝石的幸运山羊！;)
evidence.originalText:
The friendly and welcoming vibe, staff, and owner, combined with their very reasonable prices make this my favorite neighborhood coffeeshop. The only thing that would make it better would be having a local baker providing gluten free baked goods for sale here. 

Coffee is good. Very good. They carry La Colombe. And they know how to make it. They have 10 or more nice tea selections as well, a small but cared for selection of baked goods, bagals with cream cheese and lox or other toppings, and occasionally fresh fruit like a banana for sale, though it's not a full spread lunch spot by any means. I hear the bagels are fantastic.  They have remedied their drink menu issue (mentioned in another review as scattered and unclear) with a clear banner on the wall, and I find if you ask they can find a way to make it. 

There is a small outside sitting area with outdoor metal frame couches with soft clean cushions. Perfect for spring and summer days, and great spot to make new friends here in the neighborhood. 

The front room is a chill zone to work, meet people, chat with the owner when she's here, and listen to her stories of her well traveled life. Though she's sometimes quiet and unassuming while working here so you may have to be the one asking the questions to get her going.  

The staff are similar; quiet, polite, efficient, and friendly. Ask a question, start a conversation, and they're full of great life experiences to share. In fact, most of the people I've ever struck up a conversation with here have been interesting, creative, and inspiring. Maybe it's the neighborhood, maybe it's partly the caffeine, there is something special here. Un pretentious, haven't seen a man-bun ever here, and people actually smile here. That's nice.

There is a back room with board games, a soft clean sofa and 2 comfy chairs set up like a living room/sitting parlour, and a dining table and chairs, great for study groups and business meetings. 

And to add a bit of cheese...as a Capricorn, I am the Lucky Goat for finding this gem! ;)

有一个小的户外座位区，配有金属框架沙发和柔软干净的靠垫。非常适合春天和夏天，也是在这里社区结交新朋友的好地方。

前厅是一个放松的区域，可以工作、见人、和老板聊天（她在的时候），听她讲述她旅行丰富的生活故事。虽然她有时在工作时安静而不张扬，所以你可能需要主动提问才能让她开口。

员工也类似：安静、礼貌、高效、友好。问个问题，开始对话，他们就有丰富的生活经历可以分享。事实上，我在这里搭过话的大多数人都很有趣、有创意、鼓舞人心。也许是社区的原因，也许是咖啡因的作用，这里有些特别的东西。不装腔作势，从没见过男士发髻，人们真的会微笑。这很好。

后面有一个房间，有棋盘游戏、一张柔软干净的沙发和两把舒适的椅子，布置得像客厅/会客室，还有一张餐桌和椅子，非常适合学习小组和商务会议。

再加点俗气的话……作为摩羯座，我是发现这颗宝石的幸运山羊！;)

evidence.text: 这篇评论写的是位于 Pine Street、9 街和 10 街之间的新开第二家分店。今天早上我进去看看这里的咖啡。从 Washington Square 街区到市中心之间，能喝到好咖啡的咖啡馆选择很少（而且我已经厌倦了看着空着的 Ethnics 店面），所以 Good Karma Cafe 是这个街区受欢迎的新成员。我点了一杯冰咖啡——很高兴知道他们有两种尺寸，16 和 20 盎司，还会加一份浓缩咖啡（不额外收费），并且也有豆奶。我决定拿着杂志和咖啡坐下来感受新空间的氛围——它非常开阔，但仍然有点空，稍微缺少让咖啡馆显得诱人的那种舒适感。我本来想坐到空间后方侧面的房间，但那里空气有点闷，所以又移到前面。音乐增添了不错的放松氛围，大幅画作也给原本白色的墙面增加了一些色彩。靠近柜台的前方空间有点空旷，除了两个不太好看的饮料冷柜之外没有什么——如果这里能有更多桌子，或者一条带凳子的吧台，会很好。里面还有一台 ATM，如果你需要一点额外现金，可能算不错（不确定咖啡馆是否接受刷卡）……不过如果机器声音能关掉会更好——每按一下按钮都会大声哔一声，如果你在阅读或学习会有点分散注意力。此外，以这个空间大小来说，在他们开业前，我原本期待它更像一家咖啡馆——那种除了咖啡、茶等之外，还提供汤和三明治的地方，也许最终会有？这个社区真的很需要一个能快速买到三明治或小吃的选择。抛开这些不说，我知道他们才开业大约一周半，还在适应新空间，所以我肯定还会再来。
evidence.originalText:
This review is for the newly opened second location on Pine Street between 9th and 10th street.  i stopped in this morning to check out the coffee here.  The cafe options for good coffee are sparse between the Washington Square neighborhood and center city (and I had grown tired of looking at the empty Ethnics space), the Good Karma Cafe is a welcome addition to the neighborhood.  

I ordered an iced coffee - its good to know they come in two sizes - 16 and 20 oz, along with a shot of espresso (at no additional charge), and that they also carry soy milk.  I decided to sit down with a magazine and my coffee and take in the atmosphere of the new space- its very open and still feels a bit empty- somewhat lacking the cozy atmosphere that makes a cafe seem so inviting.  I went to take a seat in the side room towards the back of the space, but the air felt a bit stuffy there so moved towards the front.  The music added a nice chilled out vibe, and the large paintings added some color to the otherwise white walls.  

The space up front near the counter is a bit barren, with the exception of two not-so-pretty drink coolers- it would be nice to see more tables here, or a counter with some stools.  There is also an atm inside, nice I suppose if you need a bit of extra cash (not sure if the cafe takes cards)...however, it would be nicer if the sound on the machine could be turned off- it beeps loudly every time a button is pressed- kind of distracting if you are reading or studying. Additionally, with the size of the space, before they opened, I was expecting more of a cafe- the kind that serves soups and sandwiches, in addition to coffee, tea etc., maybe this will happen eventually?  It would really be nice to have a quick sandwich/snack option in the neighborhood.

All things aside, I know they've only been open for about a week and a half and are still getting used to the new space, so I'll definitely return.

A few months ago, I was told be a couple of friends to try out Chink's in the Northeast, and after been hounded repeatedly, I decided to give it a shot.

I knew when I walked into that place I was in for a treat, when I saw the texture of the meat and how it was cooked. Lo and behold, that steak was unlike anything I've EVER had. Incredible taste, and a nice size steak. For the price, it's a huge bargain. I walked out of that place feeling like I ripped THEM off!

I'll always love Ishkibble's, but I can no longer tell people they have my favorite cheesesteak. That crown now goes to Chinks!

I find that many places that have fancy coffee make it look and taste way too dark.  The iced caramel coffee here was noticeably caffeinated, but didn't taste too strong and acidic, so that was a real treat.  I also appreciated the offering of vegan options in food and drinks.  

Really nothing negative to say here!  Someday I shall try some other foods/drinks, but for now at least, I'm a fan.

evidence.text: 今年我圣诞愿望清单的第一项，是有人能在我家附近开一家巨大、友好、有 WiFi、有很多插座、空间宽敞的咖啡馆。现在还没有实现，但有人在 Washington West 开了一家，这完全不公平，因为从 Good Karma 走到 Chapterhouse 那一带的好地方也很方便。我先压住自己的怨念，只庆幸如果我真的急着去咖啡馆，可以比以前少走整整两个街区。Good Karma 很大、很明亮，有很多插座和 WiFi。除了咖啡和茶之外，还有很多烘焙食品和其他饮品可选，这点不错。他们还有两个不错的洗手间，也没人打扰你，而且营业到很晚。这会是咖啡馆之爱吗？缺点是食物不算好。店里有牌子告诉你不要带外食，我必须尊重，但我也必须承认，当我咬下一块湿润、蛋味过重的司康时，想到外面有 Metropolitan Bakery 做的那些优秀司康，心里会有点难过。就普通滴滤咖啡来说，咖啡还可以，但正如另一位 Yelp 用户说的，拿铁差很多。他们似乎分不清拿铁和卡布奇诺。我点过一次，之后就再也没点过。可我能说什么呢。为了这里真正友好的氛围，我可以忍受糟糕的司康和普通的咖啡饮品；一想到这个街区如此被宠坏，而我住的那片完全没有这种优秀咖啡馆，我嫉妒得脸都像他们的杯子一样绿了。哦，只收现金，不过店内有一台手续费很贵的 ATM。
evidence.originalText:
At the top of my Christmas list this year is that someone would open a huge, friendly coffeehouse near my house with WiFi and plenty of outlets and a lot of room. It hasn't happened yet but someone opened one up in Washington West which is totally not fair since Good Karma is an easy walk from the awesomeness of Chapterhouse.

I'll forestall my bitterness for now and just be glad that I can stop walking a whole two blocks than before if I really must be at a coffeehouse that much sooner. Good Karma is BIG and bright and has a lot of outlets and WiFi. There's a large selection of baked good and drinks other than coffee and tea. That's cool. They have two nice bathrooms, too, and no one bothers you and they're open late. Could this be coffeehouse love?

The downsides are the food's not great. There's a sign telling you not to bring food from elsewhere which I must respect but I must admit to being a little sad inside when I have to bite into one of their moist, overly eggy scones knowing there are great ones out there made by our own Metropolitan Bakery. The coffee's fine, as far as a brew is concerned but as a fellow Yelper said, the lattes leave much to be desired. They're confused as to what makes a latte and what makes a cappuccino. I ordered one once and none since. 

But what can I say. I'll take the bad scones and indifferent coffee drinks for the genuine friendliness of the place and my face is as green as their mugs when I think about how spoiled that neighborhood is while my part of town is totally bereft of coffeehouse awesomeness.

Oh, cash only though there's an expensive ATM on the premises.
